metadata.name: Nightlio
metadata.description: Nightlio is a privacy-first mood tracker and daily journal designed for effortless self-hosting. Log your daily mood on a simple five-point scale, write rich Markdown journal entries with customizable tags, and view insightful analytics including mood history calendars, average mood trends, and journaling streaks. All data is stored in a local SQLite database on your own server with no telemetry, ads, or subscriptions.
metadata.tagline: Privacy-first mood tracker and daily journal
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: SECRET_KEY
environment_variables.description: Secret key used by the API for session signing. Change to a long random string

environment_variables.name: JWT_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens. Change to a different long random string

environment_variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the API directly. Add your public domain when exposing the app

environment_variables.name: ENABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH
environment_variables.description: Enables Google OAuth for multi-user support (1 to enable, 0 to disable)

environment_variables.name: ENABLE_MOOD_MUSIC
environment_variables.description: Enables the mood music feature powered by Jamendo (1 to enable, 0 to disable)

environment_variables.name: DEFAULT_SELF_HOST_ID
environment_variables.description: Identifier of the default single-user account in self-hosted mode

volumes.description: SQLite database storage for moods, journal entries, and achievements

ports.description: Web UI served by nginx, which proxies /api requests to the Flask backend
